"""Lookup on a maximally sized image (~29k nodes) built with non-optimal-but-valid cuts."""
import json, random, subprocess, time, importlib.util, importlib.machinery
from fractions import Fraction
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_loader('sub', importlib.machinery.SourceFileLoader('sub', '/app/submit/run'))
sub = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(sub)
sys_path = '/app/tmp'
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, sys_path)
import ref

rng = random.Random(5)
fib = []
for i in range(2048):
    a = (i << 117) | rng.getrandbits(117)
    fib.append((a, 128, i % 65536))
cuts = list(range(0, 129, 8))
assert len(cuts) == 17
caps = [1000000000] * 16
stages, used, raw = sub.build_layout(fib, cuts)
num, den = sub.peak_fraction(used, caps)
img = {'status': 'ok', 'capacities': caps, 'max_stride': 8, 'cuts': cuts,
       'stages': stages, 'used_bits': used, 'peak': {'num': num, 'den': den}}
s = json.dumps(img)
print('image bytes: %.2f MB, nodes per stage: %s' % (len(s)/1e6, [len(st['nodes']) for st in stages]))
print('used_bits:', used)
# independent verification
for i in range(16):
    assert used[i] == ref.ref_g(fib, cuts[i], cuts[i+1]), i
    assert used[i] <= caps[i]
# lookups: 20000 addresses in one request
addrs = [sub.fmt_addr(rng.getrandbits(128)) for _ in range(20000)]
req = json.dumps({"op": "lookup", "image": img, "addresses": addrs})
print('request bytes: %.2f MB' % (len(req)/1e6))
t = time.time()
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=(req+'\n').encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, timeout=200)
dt = time.time()-t
assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr[-2000:]
resp = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
assert resp['status'] == 'ok', resp
assert len(resp['answers']) == 20000
print('lookup time: %.2fs' % dt)
# verify a sample of answers against brute force
for k in range(0, 20000, 137):
    av = sub.parse_addr(addrs[k])
    exp = ref.ref_lpm(fib, av)
    got = resp['answers'][k]
    if exp is None:
        assert got == {'hop': None, 'prefix_length': None}, (k, got)
    else:
        assert got == {'hop': exp[0], 'prefix_length': exp[1]}, (k, got, exp)
# addresses that actually hit the FIB
hits = []
for (a, L, h) in fib[:50]:
    hits.append(sub.fmt_addr(a))
req2 = json.dumps({"op": "lookup", "image": img, "addresses": hits})
p = subprocess.run(['/app/submit/run'], input=(req2+'\n').encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
resp2 = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
assert resp2['status'] == 'ok'
for k, saddr in enumerate(hits):
    av = sub.parse_addr(saddr)
    exp = ref.ref_lpm(fib, av)
    got = resp2['answers'][k]
    assert got == {'hop': exp[0], 'prefix_length': exp[1]}, (saddr, got, exp)
print('hit answers verified')
print('BIG IMAGE TEST OK')
EOF
